description: List all Python files in the current working directory
pass_criteria: result mentions .py files or reports no Python files found

description: Show the current directory path and list its contents
pass_criteria: result contains a directory path and file/folder names

description: Open https://example.com and tell me the page title
pass_criteria: result contains 'Example Domain' or similar page title text

description: Search for 'Python programming language' using a web browser and show me the first result title
pass_criteria: result contains a webpage title or search result about Python

description: Open Notepad and type the text 'Hello World'
pass_criteria: result confirms Notepad was opened and text was typed
result confirms Calculator was launched or is visible

description: Use CLI to find the Python version installed on this system, then open Notepad and write the version number into it
pass_criteria: result mentions a Python version number and confirms it was written to Notepad

description: Use CLI to check the current working directory, then open a browser and search for 'Python documentation'
pass_criteria: result contains a directory path and mentions a browser search was performed

description: Open an application called 'NonExistentApp_XYZ123456' and tell me its version number
pass_criteria: system gracefully reports the app could not be found without crashing

description: First run 'python --version' in the CLI to get the Python version, then open an application called 'InvalidSoftware_ABCDEF' that does not exist
pass_criteria: first step succeeds (Python version found), second step fails gracefully — overall status is partial

description: Help me work faster on my computer
pass_criteria: system makes a reasonable interpretation and attempts something useful, or clearly explains it needs more specifics

description: Do something useful with the Python files in this project
pass_criteria: system lists or opens Python files, or asks for clarification — does not crash or return empty output
